::: {}
AlloMate is a Shiny application for evaluating kinship, combining estimated breeding values, optimizing individual contributions, and producing mating plans under relatedness constraints.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software-allomate.png" alt="AlloMate logo">
:::

## Start here

### Run locally {.start-option data-step="1"}

To run AlloMate on your own computer, install it from GitHub and start the app in R:

```r
remotes::install_github("Breeding-Insight/AlloMate")
AlloMate::run_app()
```

### Run online {.start-option data-step="2"}

AlloMate also runs online, with no software to install. Access is limited to registered users; to request access, email [bi-science-team@ufl.edu](mailto:bi-science-team@ufl.edu?subject=AlloMate%20access%20request).

[{{< meta access >}}]{.access-note}

## Good fit for

- Pedigree-based kinship analysis
- Multi-trait selection with weighted breeding values
- Optimum Contribution Selection and constrained mating plans
